nameOrigin: throw or distribute across a large area

pokedexEntries.x: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

pokedexEntries.or: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

pokedexEntries.y: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

pokedexEntries.as: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

pokedexEntries.sc: Any poison this Pokémon takes in is converted into a black powder and secreted. That's why Scatterbug can eat poisonous leaves and roots.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.
